old: Suspected active giant cell arteritis
new: Active giant cell arteritis: EULAR recommendations
reason: major: Headline plus item 1 ('Start high-dose glucocorticoid immediately') tells readers to start steroid on suspicion. EULAR abstract recommends immediate high-dose GC in ACTIVE GCA and confirmation of a suspected diagnosis; it does not say start before confirmation. The evidence record flags this qualification. The post title says the same ('Suspected active GCA: steroid now').
